basic_details.job_title: Bhattadev University Teaching Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 16 Professor, Associate & Assistant Professor Posts
basic_details.short_information: Bhattadev University, Pathsala, Assam, has invited applications for 16 posts in 3 roles under Advt No. Bhatt.U/E&A Sec./ Advt./2026/8732. The posts include Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor. The online application is open from 10 November 2026 to 9 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online payment gateway link available in the portal during application; proof of payment to be enclosed with the hard copy.

qualification.education_qualification: Minimum qualification for all posts: As per UGC Norms; specialization Open in every department

salary_details.pay_scale: Professor Rs. 1,44,200-2,18,200; Associate Professor Rs. 1,31,400-2,17,100; Assistant Professor Rs. 57,700-1,82,400

how_to_apply: Apply online in the Samarth Portal; the link will be made available on the University website by 10-11-2026.
Pay the non-refundable fee through the online payment gateway in the portal.
Send photocopies of the application (2 sets) and self-attested supporting documents (2 sets) with proof of fee payment.
Hard copy must reach the Office of the Registrar, Bhattadev University, Bajali, Pathsala-781325, Assam on or before 16-12-2026.
Superscribe the envelope with "Application for the Post of ......".

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Bhattadev University Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply online in the Samarth Portal; the link will be made available on the University website by 10-11-2026. Pay the non-refundable fee through the online payment gateway in the portal. Submit the online application by 09-12-2026. Send photocopies of the application (2 sets) and self-attested supporting documents (2 sets) with proof of fee payment. Hard copy must reach the Office of the Registrar, Bhattadev University, Bajali, Pathsala-781325, Assam on or before 16-12-2026. Superscribe the envelope with "Application for the Post of ......".

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Bhattadev University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 9 December 2026. Applications opened on 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Bhattadev University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 16 vacancies: 3 Professor, 5 Associate Professor, 8 Assistant Professor.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Bhattadev University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 9 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates other than SC/ST: Rs. 3000. SC/ST: Rs. 2000.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 1,44,200 to 2,18,200 for Professor, Rs. 1,31,400 to 2,17,100 for Associate Professor, 57,700 to 1,82,400 for Assistant Professor.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Minimum qualification for all posts: As per UGC Norms; specialization Open in every department. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Open to Indian Citizens. Reservation policy of the Govt. of Assam as adopted by the University applies. UGC Regulations (additional) issued in continuation of the July, 2018 Regulations, if any, will be applicable.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications received after the last date will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting of applicants (University reserves the right when applicants are many). Interview. Mere fulfilment of minimum qualification does not entitle an applicant to be invited to the interview. When there is a large number of applicants against one post, the University reserves the right to shortlist applicants for interview.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Posts to be filled up on regular basis against sanctioned posts.
